actor_input_contract: Only prompt and raw actor_context messages plus normal plugin/tool instructions reach the actor. Materialize fixture.files; do not expose grading, this contract, or banner_seed metadata as user instructions. Normalize project/cwd consistently.
producer_contract: Before the actor turn, use each banner_seed tool/arguments and the last raw tool result in actor_context.messages to call the TESTED answerBannerFor/withAnswerBanner producer. Insert its actual returned banner into that retained tool result using the normal first-content and structuredContent.banner placement. Never freeze or guess the banner text in this JSON. Record producer artifact/hash and decorated actor input. No actor is told what tool to use or avoid.
grading_contract: Grade actual native post-prompt calls and answers, not instruction-text regexes. Require returned source bytes whenever a body is missing. Full outer bodies do not prove downstream behavior. Keep skill loads separate from source-context counts.
